digest.dek: What 7 major outlets covered for Friday, November 27, ranked by how widely each story was reported.
digest.overview: 170 distinct stories ran across 7 major outlets in the latest news cycle. The most widely covered was “Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone attack; Trump says Iran war ends ‘whenever I want it’”, reported by 5 outlets (BBC, CNBC, CNN, Fox News, WSJ). It was followed by “European Central Bank set to appoint its first Spanish leader” and “After the Iowa Detonation, a Family Gathered for an Unusual Thanksgiving”. World Affairs dominated the agenda, accounting for 2 of the top 8 stories. Words that kept coming up: kuwait, italian, drone, two, central, bank.
